title: Career Roadmap · Automobile Mechanic
summary: An Automobile Mechanic inspects, services, diagnoses and repairs vehicle engines, transmissions, brakes, steering, suspension and electrical systems, increasingly including electronic diagnostics and hybrid / EV components.

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
Vehicle servicing • Engine repair • Brake and suspension systems • Electrical diagnostics • OBD scanning • Preventive maintenance.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Science and Mathematics for the common ITI MMV route; confirm the current trade notification.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 is useful but not always necessary for ITI entry.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: State ITI counselling or institute-specific admission.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Automobile engines, vehicle electronics, EV fundamentals and workshop safety.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Mechanical reasoning, measurement, troubleshooting, digital tools and safe workshop practice.

rows.text: Cars, vans and light / heavy vehicle systems
EV service and maintenance, where offered
Advanced diagnostics, service operations and technical roles

blocks.label: Alternative route
blocks.text: Class 10 → Diploma in Automobile / Mechanical Engineering → Service technician, diagnostic technician or workshop technical roles, subject to employer requirements.

blocks.text: DGT lists Mechanic Motor Vehicle as a two-year CTS trade, with Class 10 Science and Mathematics or an accepted equivalent as the entry qualification. Mechanic Diesel and Mechanic Two & Three Wheeler are alternative trade routes. Verify availability through DGT and NCVT MIS.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Workshop safety, engine basics, hand tools, measurements and vehicle systems.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Technical skills
blocks.text: Servicing, lubrication, brakes, suspension, transmission and electrical fundamentals.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Diagnostic scanners, sensors, electronic control systems, fuel injection, hybrid and EV awareness.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Supervised repairs, service records, practical assessments and apprenticeship applications.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Prepare a preventive-maintenance checklist • Inspect a brake-system training assembly • Practise fault diagnosis on a training engine • Use a diagnostic scanner on a suitable training vehicle.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Transport workshops, railway workshops and eligible public-sector vehicle-maintenance units.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Automobile dealerships, authorised service centres, fleet operators, garages, component manufacturers and EV service companies.

blocks.label: Ideal training areas
blocks.text: Periodic servicing • Engine diagnostics • Vehicle electrical systems • Brake and suspension repair • EV safety awareness.
Search Apprenticeship India and official automotive company career pages. Vacancies, eligibility and stipends depend on each employer.

blocks.label: Diagnostic route
blocks.text: Workshop experience + diagnostic training → Automotive Diagnostic Technician.

blocks.label: Diesel route
blocks.text: Mechanic Diesel training → Diesel Engine / Fleet Maintenance Technician.

blocks.label: EV route
blocks.text: Relevant EV training + safety instruction → EV Service Technician, subject to employer requirements.

blocks.label: Further education
blocks.text: Eligible diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering → Service engineering, workshop management or technical support roles.
Relevant programs

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Engine overhaul • Vehicle electronics • Diagnostics • Diesel systems • Hybrid / EV maintenance • Fleet servicing • Workshop operations.

items.text: EV Service Technician, with suitable training

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Automobile dealerships, independent garages, fleet management, logistics, vehicle manufacturing, transport services and EV service networks.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Vehicle servicing, mechanical troubleshooting, electrical fundamentals, fault diagnosis, component replacement and maintenance documentation.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Diagnostic scanners, multimeters, torque wrenches, vehicle lifts, engine tools and manufacturer diagnostic systems.
Useful credentials

items.text: EV safety and diagnostics training for relevant roles.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Canada, Australia, UK and New Zealand.

blocks.label: Training routes
blocks.text: Recognized vocational colleges offering automotive technology, motor mechanics, diesel technology or EV maintenance.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Previous education or trade experience, language proficiency where applicable, practical assessments and study documentation. Trade recognition and licensing requirements vary by country.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Automotive Technician, Motor Mechanic, Diesel Mechanic, Vehicle Diagnostic Technician and EV Service Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Vehicle dealerships, fleet maintenance, transport, manufacturing and EV service.
